prompts.elowenMedoResultPrompt: Create ONE transparent PNG waist-up character bust: ELOWEN, TERRIFIED. Reference is the exact character to preserve: lean adult elf huntress, long pointed ears, tied-back light hair with loose strands framing face, travel shirt with rolled sleeves, leather straps and bracers, bow and quiver. Keep her original face and outfit, and original hand-drawn black ink lines and crosshatching with flat parchment beige / muted sepia coloring. Not realistic painting, not redesigned armor. Her eyes are wide, searching for escape slightly to the side, inner brows raised, mouth parted with a held breath, shoulders tense. One hand defensively held near chest, other gripping bow near torso. Real palpable fear, not exaggerated comedy. Portrait composition waist-up, fully contained head, ears, arms and hands, transparent background actual alpha. No text, frame, background, blood or other characters. This will be a matched terror/bravery pair: stable three-quarter frontal camera and clear silhouette.

Gorvak name is warmer and slightly brighter; small restrained warm underline below it as focus indicator. No heading at top, no instruction label, no buttons, no HUD, no timers, no cursor, no watermark, no tiny labels. Serious oppressive dark fantasy atmosphere, ink-and-parchment characters must remain recognizable and not be repainted photorealistically. Fixed layout for subsequent versions: only focused character, its brightness/expression and quoted sentence will change.
